Lila (Design): usability/a11y review note — Insights table row expanders are not keyboard discoverable and SR feedback is confusing. In testing with VoiceOver the expander key reads as 'Toggle details' but when you press Enter nothing announced and focus jumps visually but SR says nothing. Also selected row styling on dark theme has low contrast when active. Screenshot + recording: https://figma.redwood.app/insights-table-expand Evan (Frontend): thanks. Repro here. DOM currently renders each row with a clickable
and an icon span for chevron. We're not using a proper Model Embed 42 ... Detailed content... ``` On toggle we set aria-expanded to true and aria-hidden to false on the details row. Keep focus on the button. Also add aria-live="polite" region for status: "Details expanded for Model Embed 42" so users who rely on SR get explicit feedback. Sanaa (Accessibility): solid. A few extra nits: 1) use sr-only label that includes context (name + row index) to avoid ambiguous names; 2) when using aria-controls, make sure the controlled element has an accessible name or labelledby; 3) avoid announcing large HTML blobs via aria-live — the polite status message is fine. For keyboard navigation, tabbable elements should follow a logical sequence: checkbox/select -> row toggle -> primary actions. Also ensure skip-links exist so keyboard users can jump to the table from top controls. Marco (QA): I'll add tests: keyboard only flow should tab to the toggle button, press Space/Enter to expand, SR transcript should include 'Details expanded for Model Embed 42' once, and aria-expanded should flip. Also visual snapshots to assert selected-row background contrast in dark/light themes. Which color should we use? the current selected background (#0b1220) with selected text #9ca3af is failing for low contrast. Lila (Design): switch proposal: selected background to #0f172a and selected text to #e6eef8 for a stronger effect. Keep subtle left border accent in brand blue. Also increase focus ring on buttons to 3px and add slight glow in dark theme. Evan (Frontend): will implement structural change (button toggles + aria-expanded/aria-controls + aria-hidden on details row) and CSS changes for selected/focus states. Example focus rule: ``` .row-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #60a5fa; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px rgba(96,165,250,0.08); } .selected-row { background: #0f172a; color: #e6eef8; border-left: 3px solid var(--blue-500); } ``` Sanaa (Accessibility): please ensure the outline isn't the sole indicator (also change background or include left border) so users who don't perceive color changes still get spatial cueing. Also run with VoiceOver, NVDA, JAWS on Windows and VoiceOver on mac. Marco (QA): I'll add automated assertions for aria-expanded toggling and an accessibility smoke capturing SR transcripts for one expand/collapse flow across browsers. Also add visual contrast checks for selected state per WCAG. Lila (Design): owners: Evan (implement), Sanaa (a11y review), Marco (QA). Target: small patch next week. figma-bot: Updated Figma file: Insights table 1 (https://figma.redwood.app/file/insights-table-rows)
